reason: A theme and layout plugin that applies selectable VSCode Red and Solarized palettes through design-token overrides, provides settings for light and dark mappings, and supports third-party palette registration.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供可切换的 VSCode Red 和 Solarized 配色，并通过设置与注册 API 支持主题调色板管理。
summaries.en: Provides selectable VSCode Red and Solarized palettes for DeepSeek Harness with settings-based mapping and an API for registering third-party palettes.

capabilities: Provides built-in light and dark color palettes
Overrides interface design tokens at runtime
Adds plugin settings for selecting palettes
Exposes a client-side API for third-party palette registration
Persists palette mappings in the user settings document
